name: security-script-integrity-review
intent: Subresource integrity and script provenance at mutable external script loads
artifacts: HTML/module loading graph, integrity/crossorigin attributes, runtime script loader, owned dependency mirror and failure handling.
trace: Follow which external bytes execute, including fallback loaders and dynamically added scripts. Establish who can change the resource before assigning compromise impact.
experiment: On an owned mirror replace one script with a harmless altered marker and compare the intended hash match, mismatch rejection and fallback behavior.
disproof: Missing SRI alone is not a demonstrated vendor compromise; a changed script that never executes is not a provenance failure.
repair: Pin or independently verify intended resources and retest normal loading, rejection and every fallback capable of executing code.
branch_decisions: Check module/preload and dynamic-loader paths independently; a verified initial script can load unverified descendants. For cross-origin resources include the actual CORS mode in the fixture. Establish a lower-trust publisher and executing fallback before claiming dependency compromise rather than missing defense in depth.
operational_method: When integrity metadata contains several supported algorithms, derive the strongest supported algorithm and compare against its candidate digest set; matching a weaker digest does not rescue a failed stronger supported set. Retain exact fetched response bytes and the actual browser load result. Separate unsupported algorithms, CORS rejection and integrity failure in diagnostics before attributing an altered-script execution to SRI.
